description: Use when you need to know whether GPU rental prices moved. Lists list-price changes since a date for one chip or provider, newest first, up to 100 rows, each with its source. 50 free calls a day, then $0.01 USDC on Base per call via x402.

chip.description: GPU family, for example H100. Give chip, provider or both.

limit.description: Most rows to return, newest first. At most 100.

provider.description: Cloud provider: AWS or Azure. Give chip, provider or both.

since.description: ISO date, YYYY-MM-DD. Changes after this date.

name: list-price-changes
title: GPU list price changes
